about.description:
pyscal is a python module for the calculation of local
atomic structural environments including Steinhardt's bond
orientational order parameters [1] during post-processing
of atomistic simulation data. The core functionality of
pyscal is written in C++ with python wrappers using
pybind11 which allows for fast calculations with possibilities
for easy expansion in python.
about.summary: Python library written in C++ for calculation of local atomic structural environment

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: pyscal
  version: "2.10.21"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/srmnitc/${{ name }}/archive/${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: a89fc93694b3dcccbbc93723973c6a78e8ea79f1f244125a318de4e46bd6c165

build:
  number: 1
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: python
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: numpy
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - setuptools
    - numpy
    - pybind11
  run:
    - python
    - pip
    - ase
    - pybind11

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - pyscal
      pip_check: true

about:
  license: GPL-3.0-only
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Python library written in C++ for calculation of local atomic structural environment
  description: |
    pyscal is a python module for the calculation of local
    atomic structural environments including Steinhardt's bond
    orientational order parameters [1] during post-processing
    of atomistic simulation data. The core functionality of
    pyscal is written in C++ with python wrappers using
    pybind11 which allows for fast calculations with possibilities
    for easy expansion in python.
  homepage: https://pyscal.org
  repository: https://github.com/srmnitc/pyscal/
  documentation: https://pyscal.org

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jan-janssen
    - srmnitc
